analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of 'wait-and-see' maintained. RSI entered oversold territory (34.5), but ADX at 18.8 indicates no trend formation. MACD histogram is improving (-0.0032) but in weak convergence. A weak pattern confirmed with 5-day low ($1.18) matching 20-day low ($1.18) and 5-day high ($1.34) below 20-day high ($1.40). Current price ($1.20) is near the lower Bollinger Band ($1.20). Volume surged 1.62x the 5-day average, but lacks trend confirmation. 52-week position is low at 13.2%. Range-bound between support at $1.13 and resistance at $1.26. Further indicator confirmation needed for directional decision.
